subject: MAP: PromptPack credentialing, ephemeral sandbox access, and closure cadence
messages:
From: Jordan Meyers <jm@lexicon.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Assessment materials & acceptance criteria for small pilot

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited to run a focused evaluation of Redwood. We want to provision a small sandbox with a PromptPack (10k prompts) and a short testcase set (200) to validate latency & answer quality on our retail search workload.

Questions/asks:
- Can you provide the PromptPack and a short MAP (mutual action plan) that lists acceptance criteria, sandbox window, and what we can/can't do with the datasets?
- We will need an encrypted transfer and an ephemeral account for our engineers.
- Also: any SOC2 evidence we can share with our InfoSec team would speed up approval.

I've attached our internal spec (Lexicon-POC-reqs.pdf). Proposed runway: 1-week sandbox, pilot start target Aug 20.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Meyers
Head of ML Eng, Lexicon.ai

---
Attachment: Lexicon-POC-reqs.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jm@lexicon.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Assessment materials & acceptance criteria for small pilot

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. High level plan below (I'll attach a one-page MAP and checklist):

1) Artifacts we will provision: PromptPack v1 (ephemeral, encrypted), acceptance testcases (200), and a short readme with canonical prompts and scoring rubric.
2) Access window: 7 calendar days by default; we can extend by mutual agreement.
3) Usage constraints: artifacts are for evaluation only (no redistribution, no model probing for data extraction beyond the rubric). Full constraints enumerated in attached mpa_checklist.xlsx.
4) Security: we'll provide a time-limited S3 presigned bundle and rotate credentials daily. For InfoSec, attaching our SOC2 evidence summary (SOC2-evidence-redwood.pdf).

Next steps:
- Please confirm the sandbox start date (Aug 20 works from our side).
- Have your legal/security sign the short MAP (I can send via DocuSign).
- I'll ask Karthik to stage the package and provide ephemeral credentials.

On the attachments: promptpack_v1.zip will be staged to a locked bucket and will be accessible only during the window.

Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: mpa_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Attachment: SOC2-evidence-redwood.pdf (application/pdf)

On Tue, Aug 11, 2026 at 11:03 AM Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. High level plan below (I'll attach a one-page MAP and checklist):

Quick technical notes from infra:
- We'll stage promptpack_v1.zip to an S3 bucket with SSE-KMS and generate a presigned URL valid for 48 hours.
- Ephemeral IAM creds will be scoped-down (GetObject only) and will expire at the end of each day — we will publish a short script to refresh.
- Network: IP allowlist available on request; if Lexicon wants a VPN tunnel we can enable it under Redwood Private (separate contract).
- Telemetry: we will provide per-request latency and token counts in the console; we'll share a sample dashboard link once the load starts.

Acceptance checklist (excerpt):
- 200 testcases pass with >= 80% accuracy per your rubric
- 95th percentile latency under 250ms for the canonical prompt set
- No data exfiltration or queries that violate the usage constraints in the MAP

I'll push the staged promptpack to the locked bucket after DocuSign signature and a countersigned MPA. We also need a signed data usage affidavit from Lexicon (one paragraph).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Jordan — great, thanks. Final items and timeline below:

1) DocuSign: I sent the short MAP and data usage affidavit this morning (link: https://docusign.com/EXAMPLE/LD-8921). Please route to your legal and sign; countersignature will unlock the artifacts.
2) Staging and access: once we receive the signed DocuSign, Karthik will upload promptpack_v1.zip to the locked bucket and send a presigned URL. Expect first presigned URL on Aug 19 (48hr validity) and a daily credential refresh script.
3) Acceptance cadence: sandbox window Aug 20–Aug 26. We'll run nightly acceptance runs and share a short report on Aug 27.
4) Constraints reminder: evaluation-only use, no redistribution, and automated takedown at window close. See mpa_checklist.xlsx for full language.

If InfoSec needs a specific control artifact beyond the SOC2 summary, loop in security@lexicon.ai and cc us — we can provide an engineer to walk through controls next week.

Next step for you: sign DocuSign and reply 'confirmed' here. We'll handle staging on our side.

Thanks — Ava
